description: Retrieve the season-long FIRST Championship regional pool rankings (2025 and later). Returns every regional team ranked by pool points, with point total, rookie bonus, single-event bonus, adjustments, and per-event point breakdown. Very large (about 900 KB, one entry per regional team); for one event use get_event_regional_champs_pool_points, and for qualification outcomes use get_regional_advancement.

year.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

name: get_regional_rankings
title: Get Regional Pool Rankings
